mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 10.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers a flight to safety and reduces equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.5%, or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over 60-day horizons, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 3.0%, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy regime that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption (RSAFS) following two consecutive months of decline signals a recovery in consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 0.5% from prior two months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive after RSAFS rebounds (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 70% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakening, which reduces household income and consumption, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases over 60-day horizons, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with a decline in residential construction (HOUST), indicates a deepening demand slump, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 0.0% over last 6 months AND HOUST declines > 1.0% from prior 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
